explanation.description: Evidence summary: list every membership tier found on the page, note OCR/image gaps, and explain empty arrays.

membership_name.description: Exact plan/tier name from the page (one row per priced tier).

benefits.description: Non-priced perks as separate complete sentences (consult access, included treatments, credits, retail discounts, commitment/cancel rules). Include every bullet the page lists for this tier—not only a single "10% off" line. No duplicate bullets, markdown links, or URLs. Use [] only when the page truly lists no perks; image-only plans require OCR text first.
